messages:
maria: Morning — quick proposal for next week's triage: move from 10:00 to 9:45 (15m earlier) and add a short 5‑min async pre-read thread on Friday for owners to drop blockers. Thoughts?
sam: I'm +1 for earlier — mornings are quieter. Pre-read sounds good. Will that make it hard for APAC folks?
maria: Good point — can keep the recording + summary. Also proposal to split triage into two lanes: Hotfix (P0/P1) 1st 10 min, Backlog PRs/owner-assign 2nd 15 min. That keeps hot stuff isolated.
jamal: I like the lanes. I can own Hotfix lane next week (Mon-Wed).
lee: Can we add an 'PR unblockers' quick slot? I often have 2-3 small PRs that need a quick merge.
maria: Yes — PR unblockers as part of Backlog lane, top of that 15-min slot. Agenda draft:
```
1) Hotfix lane (10m)
2) PR unblockers (5m)
3) Backlog + owner assignment (10m)
4) Action items & owner check (5m)
```
toni: If we shorten hotfix to 8m and PR unblockers to 7m we can keep total 30. But is 30 the target? Current invites are 30, so that's fine.
sam: APAC concern — earlier time loses some overlap. Maybe rotate chairs so someone in APAC gets the owner rotation?
jamal: We could also make the Friday pre-read asynchronous: owners post 1-line status + any asks. That way APAC can contribute.
maria: Agree. Plan: move to 9:45 starting Mon, make Friday pre-read thread (owners post by EOD Thu), add PR unblockers, lane roster posted in calendar invite. @triage-bot can we auto-post the pre-read reminder on Thu 3pm PT?
triage-bot: Scheduled: Weekly pre-read reminder set for Thu 15:00 PT. Link to thread will be in the invite.
lee: Works for me. I'll take backlog owner Thurs-Fri.
toni: :thumbsup: I'll update calendar and the invite description with the agenda + owner roster. Need volunteers for next two weeks' hotfix lane (Mon-Wed)?
jamal: I'll take next week. @sam you want to take week after?
sam: Yep, I can do week after. Also will add note about where to post logs and short repro steps in pre-read.
maria: Awesome. I'll send a follow-up doc with the 'how to write a 1-line pre-read' template. Thanks team.
